mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.4% triggers a negative feedback loop where reduced labor market confidence lowers equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.4% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing the threshold, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (industrial production) signals robust economic growth, leading to positive 5-day forward returns as market anticipates sustained expansion.
candidate_trigger: simultaneous rise in GDPC1 and HOUST
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies rise, or the interaction effect is weak (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), elevated discount rates reduce the present value of future cash flows, leading to negative 60-day forward returns as investors anticipate higher inflation.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% in the next month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the tightening phase, or the effect is inconsistent across quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (supply index) above 105 signals robust production capacity, lowering inflation expectations and driving positive 20-day forward returns as investors anticipate lower growth risks.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO rises, or the effect is not sustained over multiple quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in GDPC1 (total demand) above 12,000 in the next month signals overheating demand, prompting market anticipation of inflation and positive 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 exceeds 12,000 in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 crosses the threshold, or the effect is short-lived.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in PAYEMS (employment) and UNRATE (unemployment) create a labor market paradox, boosting investor confidence and driving positive 5-day forward returns as growth expectations rise.
candidate_trigger: simultaneous rise in PAYEMS and UNRATE
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies rise, or the interaction effect is weak (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion phase (INDPRO > 105), sustained growth in production capacity reduces supply chain pressures, leading to positive 60-day forward returns as investors anticipate prolonged stability.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the late-cycle phase, or the effect is inconsistent across multiple quarters.
